events_seen: TRADE (Nov 24 (yesterday)): Adam receives 2027 R4 pick. Charles receives Tommy DeVito (QB, NE).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (3 days ago)): Adam added Phil Mafah (RB, NYG) (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (3 days ago)): Mitchum added Jaydn Ott (RB, KC) (dropped Sean Tucker (RB, TB)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (3 days ago)): Drew added Josh Johnson (QB, ARI) (dropped Tyler Goodson (RB, DAL)).
CUT (Nov 20 (5 days ago)): Mitchum released Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF).
CUT (Nov 19 (6 days ago)): Fronge released Brevyn Spann-Ford (TE, DAL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (7 days ago)): Adam added Xavier Restrepo (WR, TEN) (dropped Stetson Bennett IV (QB, LAR)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (7 days ago)): Ryan added Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Michael Carter (RB, TEN)).

WEEK 11 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Adam, 121.2-120.3 (NAIL-BITER); Jake def. Drew, 124.3-74.1 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Kevin, 115.1-87.5; Charles def. Shaq, 168.2-74.1 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Mitchum, 160.1-103.0 (BLOWOUT); Ryan def. Brent, 143.1-72.5 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger will have a full Week 12 preview in the next issue but I will say this now: Fronge vs Jake is the most underrated game on the slate. ForgeHammer just beat Kevin by nearly thirty from Havana with zero pick liquidity. EchoPoint is 12-10 with the third-best RB room in the league and an empty TE desk that eleven weeks of evidence has not convinced Jake to address. Something has to give and the Ledger will tell you which direction it falls.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew vs Mitchum in Week 12 and I am not going to pretend this is a football game. It is a referendum on whether DEEP at $104.54 can keep its playoff positioning intact against a roster that is 0-22 and still found a way to add Josh Johnson to its quarterback depth this week. Mitchum wins this by thirty. Book it.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Charles trade for DeVito is worth about four sentences of context before the rankings crowd turns it into a thesis. Crownline at 17-5 did not need DeVito for 2026 — they needed him off someone else's superflex bench before the playoff push. Adam got a 2027 fourth for a QB he was not starting. Both desks understood the transaction correctly. The market will catch up.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Terrence is picking Adam over Wingard after going 5-7 on the season and I need everyone to sit with that for a moment. The man who had Mitchum in a game Mitchum lost by fifty-three points is now fading the team that scored a hundred and sixty. This is not analysis. This is performance art.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the season and I genuinely believe Adam covers Wingard in Week 12. Yes, Sovereign just put up 160 against Mitchum. Yes, I had Mitchum in that game. The process was sound. Wingard's production discount is real and Adam's desk has moved more in the last seven days than it did in the previous six weeks combined.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Kevin fragile before Fronge outscored him out of Havana and I called the ForgeHammer angle two weeks running. Now Kevin faces Brent in Week 12 at 15-7, QB room degraded, dynasty grade dead last in the league. I called it going in and the matchup this week is not going to be easier for a roster built on a window that already closed.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, locks 2-0, and I want the segment where we talk about Charles vs Ryan this week because the narrative around that matchup is lazy. Everyone is writing it as a coronation tour for Crownline. I am not writing it that way and my record earns me the airtime to explain why.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I want to be on record before Week 12 kicks off: Corbishley vs Shaq is the most straightforward game on the slate and I am not going to overthink it. APEX at $125.49, first in receiving, 17-5. MWB at $97.99, 10-12, RB hole entering its second consecutive window unaddressed. The pick writes itself.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: TRANSACTION: Charles (Crownline, CROWN) acquired Tommy DeVito from Adam (Helix, HLX) in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round pick. DeVito lands on the roster of the 17-5 league leader. Adam gets future capital. Standard window activity — except that Adam has now added Phil Mafah, Xavier Restrepo, and DeVito's replacement depth in the last seven days. That is not a rebuild pause. That is a desk that woke up.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 12 matchups are set and the Ledger is already running the numbers. Charles vs Ryan is the headline — the regular-season king against the defending champion, 17-5 versus 11-11, and the exchange has them separated by exactly $34.45. That gap tells a story all by itself.
